profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Expert in React, TypeScript & Agile Development | Transforming Ideas into Solutions
profile.summary:
As a results-driven Full-Stack Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience, I specialize in building and optimizing web and mobile applications that drive business success. My expertise spans across React Native, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a proven track record of leading projects that have significantly enhanced user engagement and streamlined critical processes.

Recently, I spearheaded a cutting-edge project to integrate WhatsApp with a chatbot API leveraging Azure, LangChain, Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, NestJS, and OpenAI technologies, which provides real-time business updates, driving operational efficiency. My experience also includes leading the unification of a flagship app into a React Native application, resulting in a 30% increase in release speed, and developing a NextJS-based caregiver onboarding portal that expanded the user base by over 12,000 members.

I thrive in fast-paced environments where innovation meets impact. My background as a Technical Lead saw me introduce Agile methodologies that transformed team efficiency and led to more effective project management. Additionally, I have a strong passion for mentorship, having guided interns in full-stack development and modern React practices.

With a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and a solid foundation in technologies like MongoDB, Postgres, Redux, AWS, and Docker, I am well-equipped to tackle complex challenges and deliver scalable, user-centric solutions. I’m always eager to connect with fellow professionals and explore new opportunities to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what technology can achieve.

Let’s connect and explore how I can help your organization build the future of software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained key pages and features of the main production website using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Mantine, and SCSS, contributing to
scalable, high-performance customer-facing experiences.
• Developed high-performance production pages using React and Next.js, utilizing Material UI and Mantine to standardize accessible, responsive design systems.
• Architected reusable HubSpot CMS modules using HuBL and JavaScript, and integrated ButterCMS schemas and content pipelines to streamline content
management.
• Improved accessibility and user flows across public-facing applications, increasing engagement and expanding reach for underrepresented talent.
• Standardized design system components in collaboration with UX and product teams, ensuring consistency, reuse, and accessibility across client-facing
platforms.
• Collaborated with .NET backend engineers in Dockerized environments, aligning frontend behavior with backend services and APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: React · TypeScript · Next.js · Front-End Development · Internet Design

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Develop consumer-focused and responsive SaaS applications using modern technologies. Enhance usability and accessibility through optimized web-based user interactions. Collaborate with UI/UX designers to deliver high-quality user interfaces. Contribute to backend software, APIs, and data pipeline development. Build scalable and reliable applications utilizing cloud services like GCP and AWS. Write well-documented, thoroughly tested code following best practices.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · PostgreSQL · React · Node.js · Tailwind CSS · Docker Products

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Developed innovative software products utilizing cutting-edge generative AI technologies. Led the integration of WhatsApp with the company’s chatbot API, hosted on Azure, to deliver real-time business updates to employees. The chatbot leveraged  Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Twilio, and the OpenAI API for seamless operations and daily updates.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Led the development of a NextJS-based caregiver onboarding portal, increasing the user base by over 12,000 through
scalable cloud solutions and targeted UX improvements using HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Postgres, and AWS.
• Enhanced app performance and cross-platform user experience by leading the unification of the company's flagship Android
app into a React Native application, driving significant improvements in both areas.
• Led the development of the CDPAP Connect application, optimizing caregiver-patient connections for over 100 caregivers
by utilizing SCSS, TypeScript, React, Node.js, AWS, Salesforce, and MongoDB.
• Enhanced backend connectivity and performance by implementing REST APIs with Express and Node.js in the client
connection portal.
• Delivered high-quality web projects through cross-functional team collaboration, using React, React-Native, and NextJS.
Ensured timely delivery and adherence to project requirements, resulting in a 25% increase in client satisfaction and a 15%
reduction in development time.
